paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different consistency models: Consistency-CE, Consistency-Uni, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 8, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents BLEU score, also with a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 32, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot shows three lines: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Consistency-Uni (green solid line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately (1, 19.5) and increases to around (8, 31.5), with notable points at (3, 26) and (5, 29). The Consistency-Uni line begins at roughly (1.5, 25.5), rises to (4, 28), and continues to increase to (8, 32.5). The Consistency-Bi line starts at about (1, 26), increases to (4, 29.5), and further rises to (8, 32.5). All three lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the x-axis, with varying rates of increase.
